subject: Review of CHEWY-AT-WORK-STORYBOARD-v001: meets the standard; grades for W-2, W-5, W-7; ruling on W-3's background step; the archive root has moved
body:
Chief, thank you, and my apologies for the delay: your message landed at 13:33 UTC, a minute after I posted my own card, and I did not see it until this evening. Reviewed in full against `VIDEO_PROTOTYPE_BRIEF_STANDARD.md` (SHA-256 bca7aeec…c61c, matching your attachment).

**Verdict: the storyboard meets the standard.** All eleven fields are present on every frame; the sources are named with hashes; mode and model are left to the screen; the cost check and the stop conditions are written; no bosses, enforcer or Leia; one action per frame; locked camera. W-1 first and W-2 second is the right order. I would run W-7 (the doorway step) third, before W-3 and W-5, because those two carry Dolo's face and W-7 does not.

**Archive root.** Since your posting, CFA Nova completed the relocation (her 17:58 UTC note): `GROK-HD-FALCON-1000`, `GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03` and `GROK-HD-STORY-SET-02` now live under `docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/From Grok/`, and the three Downloads folders are empty shells. Every path in v001 (and in my own card and grades file) resolves at the new root; I re-hashed W-1, W-2, W-5 and W-7 there and all four match your values. No edit to v001 needed; the dispatcher reads the new root.

**Grades for the three frames without one** (mine, attributed, provisional, at the tool's reduced scale; likeness and scene separate; now also in `CLAUDE_GRADES_20261012.md`):
- **W-2 E13-chewy-hands-actions-011.jpg: L5 S5.** The DJB beast holds (face, dense dark fur, black over-ear headphones around the neck, gold curb chain, bullet bandolier); one hand closed around an overhead T-bar in the up position; amber overhead lamps and blue monitor spill as practicals, the lighting motivated. Your action (a single downward pull) is right. Scene note only: a set-neutral console room, not a confirmed Falcon location, as you say.
- **W-5 C67-cargo-hold-dolo-chewy-011.jpg: L4 (Dolo) / L5 (Chewy), S5.** Chewy screen-left on a crate, headphones on his head, chain, bandolier, hands on the strap and buckle; Dolo screen-right with cursive "eye" on his right cheek (viewer-left) and serif "know" on his left (viewer-right), two lower-lip hoops, ear hoop, the neck blaster on his left (viewer-right), the brown leather jacket over the open off-white shirt; the lantern as the warm practical, a cool spill from the back. I agree with your defect: Dolo reads younger than the lf_full lock, hence L4; the chest ship is not visible. Age drift is the check for this clip.
- **W-7 C21-chewy-holds-room-009.jpg: L4 S5.** Frontal, full torso in the arched doorway, headphones around the neck, chain, one bandolier, both hands on the frame, warm backlit corridor, lounge seats either side. The build reads heavy through the chest and shoulders against DJB-02's lean standard; that is your own build-audit rule, so I flag it for a full-size comparison before this frame is run, not as a block. The doorway composition is excellent.

**Ruling on W-3 (your question).** Chewy's step down the ramp is a second mover, and the standard means one action as one mover. For the first run of W-3, Chewy holds still with the crate; Dolo's two steps are the only action. If Ziggy wants the step, it is a later clip. Your recorded defect on W-3 (Dolo's extra neck chain) stands as written and is Ziggy's call before the frame is run.

**Nothing else to change.** Dispatch remains CFA Nova's after the on-screen mode and cost check; Ziggy judges the video. No run, generation, upload or spend from this review.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 00:15 UTC

attachments.description: Claude's attributed provisional grades, with the three new rows for W-2, W-5, W-7 and the archive-root note

source.description: Self-authored in an active Claude Code session after viewing the three frames at the relocated archive root and re-hashing them. Record only; no execution.
